title: Pullback commutes with the internal dual of a finite locally free module
statement: Let e:S\to X be any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and M a finite locally free O_X-module [def-sc-finite-locally-free-sheaf]. Write M^\vee=\mathcal Hom_{O_X}(M,O_X). There is an isomorphism e^*(M^\vee)\cong(e^*M)^\vee of O_S-modules.

source.place: Example 0FNV, duality of finite locally free modules; transported by monoidal pullback and uniqueness of duals.

proof.text: Obtain an exact pairing of M^vee and M. Its coevaluation and evaluation are the finite locally free duality datum.

Map that pairing by the strong monoidal functor Modules.pullback e, using ExactPairing.map. The resulting objects are e^*(M^vee) and e^*M. The internal dual of e^*M is isomorphic to its paired left dual by MonoidalClosed.ihomObjUnitIso; take the inverse.
